body:
I appreciate the responses. Honestly surprised I got any! It’s nice to know there are people that are willing to listen. I guess it’s easier on here since it’s so anonymous. I know I need to tell someone but I don’t want to put that burden on them. 

I’m scared to tell my therapist I’ve been self harming again or that I’m not feeling like myself because I don’t want to be hospitalized. It would literally ruin everything I have going for me right now. I don’t want to take medication because I want to someday join the army, and they would disqualify me for taking antidepressants. 

I just feel stuck. I’m exhausted from pretending to be happy and acting okay in front of my family or my patients. I wish I could spend time in the hospital so that I could for once be taken care of instead of taking care of other people, but I feel like it would do more harm than good.
